_comment: Madlog Store on Vercel — serves the Laravel admin and staff panels only.
How this works:
1. The `buildCommand` runs Composer to install PHP deps (so vendor/
livewire/flux/dist/flux.css exists for the Vite build). Then npm ci
+ npm run build to produce the admin/landing JS+CSS bundles into
public/build/assets/.
2. The `builds` block tells Vercel to compile api/index.php with the
PHP runtime. The entry point require()s public/index.php so Laravel
handles routing/sessions/CSRF as usual.
3. The `routes` block rewrites every incoming URL to api/index.php so
/login, /admin, /staff, etc. all flow through Laravel.
4. Static assets in public/ are served directly by Vercel's CDN.
REQUIRED ENV VARS (set in Vercel dashboard, NOT in this file):
APP_KEY          - 32-char base64 key (php artisan key:generate --show)
APP_URL          - https://<your-project>.vercel.app
DB_CONNECTION    - pgsql
DATABASE_URL     - Vercel Postgres connection string
(or) PGHOST/PGPORT/PGDATABASE/PGUSER/PGPASSWORD individually
SESSION_DRIVER   - database (default) or cookie for stateless
CACHE_STORE      - database
QUEUE_CONNECTION - sync (Vercel has no queue worker; use database
or sync only)
SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE - true (forces HTTPS-only session cookies)
LOG_CHANNEL      - stack (Vercel drains to its log explorer)
MAIL_MAILER      - log (or set up Resend/Postmark/ SES env vars)
VERCEL_PROJECT_PRODUCTION_URL - auto-set by Vercel; used for URL gen
BEFORE FIRST DEPLOY:
1. In Vercel dashboard, add the Postgres store from the Storage tab.
2. Copy DATABASE_URL from the connect dialog into env vars.
3. Set APP_KEY (= php -r "echo 'base64:'.base64_encode(random_bytes(32));" ).
4. Push to trigger build. After build, run `vercel env pull` + `php
artisan migrate --force` via a one-off shell (or auto-run via the
`postbuild` step below — we run it on first build to bootstrap).
name: madlog-store
buildCommand: composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --optimize-autoloader && npm ci && npm run build && php artisan storage:link || true && php artisan migrate --force || true
